one_star_reviews.text:
⭐☆☆☆☆ Extremely Disappointing – Would Not Recommend

Very disappointing experience with Little Leaders Daycare in Chestermere. My son was kicked out, and the way the situation was handled was extremely unprofessional.

The professionalism and maturity of the staff were a major concern throughout this experience. Parents expect daycare staff to be patient, understanding, respectful, and capable of handling difficult situations involving children. Unfortunately, that was not what I experienced.

Instead of feeling like parents and children are being supported, I was left feeling disappointed with how everything was dealt with.

I would strongly encourage other parents to do their research before enrolling their children here. There are much higher expectations when it comes to caring for people’s children, and in my experience, Little Leaders did not meet those expectations
